mapper.select: /* userMapper.selectUser */ SELECT U.EMAIL AS email , U.USER_NAME AS userName , U.ARCHIVE_NAME AS archiveName , CASE WHEN THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS flagArchiveNameUpdateAvailable , F.URL_PATH AS profileImageUrlPath FROM USER U LEFT JOIN `FILE` F ON F.FILE_UID = U.PROFILE_IMAGE_UID WHERE U.USER_UID = #{userUid}
/* userMapper.checkArchiveNameUpaateAvailable */ SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER WHERE USER_UID = #{userUid} AND FLAG_DELETED = 'N' AND ) AS FLAG_EXISTENCE
